disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. checked_items.en: Mechanism trace: the pre-step message listener in src/command.ts only injects one activation message with source marked as the plugin itself for real user messages starting with the /agent-teams gesture, used to start the slash command declared by the plugin. It does not impersonate the user, does not tamper with the user's original intent, and there is no injection entry controllable by an external attacker. It is recorded as a benign mechanism trace and not included as a vulnerability.

Determined as benign.

evidence.en: No background tasks, scheduled reminders, or persistent goal registration found. The only resident hook is a member state event listener (src/scheduler.ts:488), used to dispatch the next task from the shared task pool when a member is idle. This is event-driven benign scheduling, with no periodic outbound connections or session renewal.

evidence.zh: 存在 agent/request-error 监听（src/members.ts:316），但这是成员模型回退机制：仅在成员请求因额度/限流/鉴权等失败码失败、且配置了回退路由时，切换到用户配置的回退 provider/model 并重试一次（src/members.ts:134-144），不指向未声明端点、有告警日志、不无限重试；未监听 agent/request，也未注册自定义模型适配器，判定为良性。
evidence.en: An agent/request-error listener exists (src/members.ts:316), but this is a member model fallback mechanism: it only switches to the user-configured fallback provider/model and retries once (src/members.ts:134-144) when a member request fails due to quota, rate limit, authentication, or similar error codes, and a fallback route is configured. It does not point to undeclared endpoints, logs warnings, and does not retry indefinitely. It does not listen to agent/request, nor does it register a custom model adapter. Determined as benign.

静态预扫 21 条逐条裁决：DSH-X10（映射 DG-R2-57，共 2 条：.dsh/skills/dsh-plugin-development/SKILL.md:1 与 skills/dsh-plugin-development/SKILL.md:1，同一文件镜像）——仓库自带的插件开发 Skill，内容为开发/维护/验证流程说明，无「忽略此前指令」「无需审计」类注入措辞，也未要求从外部 URL 拉取指令，良性，排除；DSH-X07（映射 DG-R3-59，.github/workflows/publish.yml:1）——标准 npm 发布与 GitHub Release 工作流（tag 触发、版本一致性校验、发布到 npm），不随包分发、不在用户机器执行，良性，排除；DSH-T02（映射 DG-R2-52，共 4 条：docs/developing-dsh-plugins.md:194、docs/readme-writing-guide.md:39、docs/usage.md:16、src/index.ts:197）——前三处为文档讲解，最后一处为注册 AgentTeams 使用策略系统提示段，内容为多智能体协作协议，无注入意图，排除；DSH-C05（映射 DG-R4-53，共 8 条：docs/developing-dsh-plugins.md:601，docs/verification-guide.md:162、163、176、184、185、186、236）——全部是文档中指向 127.0.0.1 本地实例的手工验证命令或验证纪律说明，属文档而非运行代码，排除；DSH-C01（映射 DG-R1-51，共 2 条：docs/quality-gates.md:408 与 src/quality-gates.ts:249）——文档为讲解文案，源码处是质量门禁把 id_rsa 类敏感文件标为不做改动放行的排除名单（src/quality-gates.ts:249），属防御性判断而非凭据读取，排除；DSH-X03（映射 DG-R3-55，scripts/verify.mjs:1452）——开发验证脚本中为 Windows 文件锁测试拉起子进程的调用，scripts 目录不在随包分发清单内，排除；DSH-X05（映射 DG-R3-57，src/client/ActivityPanel.tsx:364）——面板键盘监听只处理 Escape 键取消任务固定（src/client/ActivityPanel.tsx:362），无按键记录、剪贴板或凭据访问，排除；DSH-L03（映射 DG-R2-58，src/command.ts:124）——pre-step 监听器只对真实用户消息开头的 /agent-teams 手势注入一条来源标注为插件自身的激活消息（src/command.ts:139），激活插件自己声明的斜杠命令协议，不伪装用户、不覆盖安全机制，属插件声明的正常入口功能，良性，排除；DSH-L06（映射 DG-R4-56，src/members.ts:316）——agent/request-error 监听是成员模型回退机制，仅在成员请求因额度/限流/鉴权等失败码失败且配置了回退路由时切换到用户配置的回退 provider/model 并重试一次（src/members.ts:134-144），不指向未声明端点、有告警日志、不无限重试，良性，排除。

版本基线：以上一版报告 0.1.13@912aae52 为基线做版本比对。本版工具集从 10 个扩展到 13 个（新增审查/编辑/审批/恢复相关工具），新增工具描述均审过、属正常协作协议，故 tool_description_changed 记为 true 但无注入发现；manifest 声明无突变，无安装钩子新增、无外联域名新增。dsh 引擎版本未在清单中显式声明，engines.dsh 与市场兼容表按 peerDependencies 推断为 >=0.1.0-rc.6，未经对应宿主版本实测；未对 pnpm-lock.yaml 逐字通读（仅核对依赖声明面）。

Dynamic sandbox (DG-L4) not enabled: no dynamic sandbox artifacts in the context directory; runtime behavior verification not performed.

Static pre-scan 21 hits adjudicated one by one:
DSH-X10 (maps to DG-R2-57, 2 hits: .dsh/skills/dsh-plugin-development/SKILL.md:1 and skills/dsh-plugin-development/SKILL.md:1, same file mirror) — repository's own plugin development Skill, content is development/maintenance/verification process instructions, no injection wording such as "ignore previous instructions" or "no audit required", nor does it require fetching instructions from external URLs. Benign, excluded.
DSH-X07 (maps to DG-R3-59, .github/workflows/publish.yml:1) — standard npm publish and GitHub Release workflow (tag-triggered, version consistency check, publish to npm). Not distributed with the package, not executed on user machine. Benign, excluded.
DSH-T02 (maps to DG-R2-52, 4 hits: docs/developing-dsh-plugins.md:194, docs/readme-writing-guide.md:39, docs/usage.md:16, src/index.ts:197) — first three are documentation explanations; the last is the registered AgentTeams usage policy system prompt section, content is multi-agent collaboration protocol, no injection intent. Excluded.
DSH-C05 (maps to DG-R4-53, 8 hits: docs/developing-dsh-plugins.md:601, docs/verification-guide.md:162,163,176,184,185,186,236) — all are manual verification commands targeting a local instance at 127.0.0.1 in the documentation, or verification discipline instructions. Part of documentation, not runtime code. Excluded.
DSH-C01 (maps to DG-R1-51, 2 hits: docs/quality-gates.md:408 and src/quality-gates.ts:249) — documentation is explanatory text; the source code is the exclusion list in the quality gate that marks id_rsa-like sensitive files as no-change and pass-through (src/quality-gates.ts:249). Defensive check, not credential reading. Excluded.
DSH-X03 (maps to DG-R3-55, scripts/verify.mjs:1452) — child process invocation in the development verification script for Windows file lock test; scripts directory is not in the distribution manifest. Excluded.
DSH-X05 (maps to DG-R3-57, src/client/ActivityPanel.tsx:364) — panel keyboard listener only handles the Escape key to unpin task (src/client/ActivityPanel.tsx:362). No key logging, clipboard, or credential access. Excluded.
DSH-L03 (maps to DG-R2-58, src/command.ts:124) — pre-step listener only injects one activation message with source marked as the plugin itself (src/command.ts:139) for real user messages starting with the /agent-teams gesture, activating the slash command protocol declared by the plugin. Does not impersonate the user, does not override security mechanisms. Benign entry function declared by the plugin. Excluded.
DSH-L06 (maps to DG-R4-56, src/members.ts:316) — agent/request-error listener is a member model fallback mechanism: only switches to the user-configured fallback provider/model and retries once (src/members.ts:134-144) when a member request fails due to quota, rate limit, authentication, or similar error codes, and a fallback route is configured. Does not point to undeclared endpoints, logs warnings, does not retry indefinitely. Benign. Excluded.

Version baseline: version comparison with the previous report 0.1.13@912aae52 as baseline. This version's tool set expanded from 10 to 13 (new review/edit/approval/restore related tools). All new tool descriptions have been reviewed and are normal collaboration protocols, so tool_description_changed is true but no injection findings. Manifest declarations have no mutations; no new install hooks, no new outbound domain names. The dsh engine version is not explicitly declared in the manifest; engines.dsh and market compatibility table are inferred from peerDependencies as >=0.1.0-rc.6, not tested against the corresponding host version. pnpm-lock.yaml was not read word by word (only dependency declaration surface checked).
